To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the positive effect of teamwork on project performance increases as team member dispersion (i.e., geographical distance) increases, that is, the effect of teamwork is stronger in dispersed teams.
the relationship between teamwork and performance is stronger when team members are more geographically dispersed.

the positive impact of high quality teamwork on team performance is stronger for dispersed than for colocated teams, and that this effect is stronger for dispersed teams with a low number of face-to-face meetings than for teams with a high number of face-to face meetings.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a phenomenon that has received increasing attention from researchers and practitioners: the impact of team member dispersion on the performance of teams.
the effect of team member dispersion on the relationship between team performance and teamwork.
how team member dispersion affects the performance of teams and how this relationship is moderated by the quality of teamwork.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
team member proximity is an important contextual factor that affects teamwork and team performance, and that this effect is moderated by team member dispersion.
teamwork quality matters more as team member dispersion decreases and that team performance is affected by the quality of teamwork, which is more difficult to reach in low proximity teams.
teamwork is important in any type of team and that the more dispersed the team, the more important it is.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
teamwork matters more as team member dispersion increase, and that the impact of teamwork on team performance increases as dispersion increases.
teamwork quality matters more for dispersed teams.
teamwork is more important for dispersed than co located teams.
The main takeaway from our work is that
teamwork quality matters even more as team member dispersion becomes more pronounced.
the quality of teamwork in dispersed teams matters more than in co located ones.
team member proximity is a key moderator of the effect of teamwork quality on project performance, and that team leaders should be aware of this.
